_comment: Validation datasets for Tessera. 'orthopox_example' uses the bundled
example_data and runs out of the box. The fetch-based datasets are
downloaded by validation/fetch.py from the listed NCBI accessions.
Accessions marked TODO must be confirmed before enabling the dataset
(set enabled=true). See validation/README.md for provenance notes.

datasets.name: orthopox_example
datasets.description: Orthopoxvirus: 8-contig synthetic cowpox query carrying a variola insert.
datasets.provenance: NCBI: camelpox NC_003391, cowpox_KC813504 KC813504.1, cowpox NC_003663, monkeypox NC_063383, taterapox NC_008291, vaccinia NC_006998, variola NC_001611. sibeliaz OOMs on these large collinear blocks on a typical laptop; minimap2 (the assembly-to-reference backend) is the practical choice for this fragmented query.

datasets.name: sarscov2_xbb
datasets.description: SARS-CoV-2 XBB: recombinant of BA.2.10.1 (5') and BA.2.75 (3'), breakpoint in spike.
datasets.provenance: XBB query OQ075387 (NCBI: SARS-CoV-2/human/BGD/icddrb-TND-06-1082/2022, XBB; Bangladesh study PMC10019308). BA.2.75 parent OQ326841 (UT-NCD1757, characterised BA.2.75; PMC10035475). Wuhan-Hu-1 NC_045512.2 (coordinate anchor). BA.2.10.1 parent OR324670 was matched by NCBI text search for 'BA.2.10.1 complete genome' -- confirm its Pango lineage (e.g. via Nextclade) before trusting it. XBB's breakpoint sits in the spike region (~genome nt 22.9 kb).

datasets.name: hiv1_crf
datasets.description: HIV-1 CRF01_AE (CM240): subtype-A backbone with a subtype-E env, vs pure subtype references plus an E-env reference.
datasets.provenance: All accessions confirmed on NCBI nuccore. Query CRF01_AE = CM240 U54771 (9203 bp). Pure subtype references: B = HXB2 K03455 (coordinate standard, 9719 bp), A1 = 92UG037 U51190, C = U46016, D = ELI K03454. Because pure subtype E exists only as the CRF01_AE env, an env-only E reference is added: AE_env = JN388230 (Thailand CRF01_AE env, 2556 bp), which aligns to the env columns and is gapped elsewhere. The query then resolves to an A1 backbone with a donor-present AE_env recombination over gp120/env (query ~5.7-8.2 kb, breakpoint near the env boundary) -- the A/E mosaic that defines CRF01_AE, as detected by jpHMM/COMET. Without AE_env the env is instead reported as a DONOR-ABSENT region (true source missing -- run find-references). The old heuristic hallucinated ~6 low-margin regions here.

datasets.name: norovirus_gii
datasets.description: Norovirus GII.P16-GII.1 recombinant: ORF1 (P16 polymerase) vs ORF2/3 (GII.1 capsid).
datasets.provenance: All accessions confirmed on NCBI nuccore. Query MG572182 (Norovirus GII isolate SDJN170450, the GII.P16-GII.1 recombinant; PMC5805878, 7518 bp). Polymerase (ORF1, ~nt 1-5.1 kb) matches a GII.P16 strain -> MK773584 (GII.P16-GII.4 Sydney, 7559 bp); capsid (ORF2/3) matches GII.1 -> U07611 (Hawaii calicivirus, GII.1, 7513 bp). Breakpoint at the ORF1/ORF2 junction (~nt 5.0 kb).

datasets.name: enterovirus_e11
datasets.description: Echovirus 11 / Coxsackievirus B1 recombinant: an E-11 capsid (P1) with a CV-B1 P2/P3, breakpoint in P2 (an enterovirus recombination hotspot).
datasets.provenance: All accessions confirmed on NCBI nuccore. Recombinant query E-11 ISO_VR_Echo11 = KX527626 (7347 bp; Virology Journal 2022, PMC9166486). Parents: E-11 = AY167103 (echovirus 11 Hun/90), CV-B1 = MG845887 (coxsackievirus B1 B1L071615). Published breakpoint at nt 4083-4201 of the recombinant (P2 region). The genome-wide backbone-vs-donor DIRECTION is left unasserted: the isolate is E-11 by VP1 typing, but which parent is the genome-wide major depends on the reference divergence, so this case checks only the unambiguous ground truth -- a recombinant involving BOTH E-11 and CV-B1, with at least one region called. Measured: Tessera detects one region and names both parents (it calls CV-B1 the major and E-11 the donor).

datasets.name: hiv_crf02ag
datasets.description: HIV-1 CRF02_AG (IbNG): subtype-A backbone with subtype-G segments (pol/vif and vpu-env), vs pure A, G and B references.
datasets.provenance: All accessions confirmed on NCBI nuccore. Query CRF02_AG = IbNG L39106 (9201 bp, the CRF02_AG prototype). Pure references: A = 92UG037 U51190, G = SE6165 AF061642, B = HXB2 K03455 (coordinate anchor). CRF02_AG is a subtype-A backbone with subtype-G segments (inter-subtype breakpoints near HXB2 nt 4218-5518 in pol/vif and 5957-8250 in vpu/rev/tat/env; Front. Cell. Infect. Microbiol. 2023, PMC10642767). The multi-breakpoint mosaic is scored on detection + A-backbone / G-donor attribution rather than a single tight breakpoint.

datasets.name: sarscov2_xe
datasets.description: SARS-CoV-2 XE: recombinant of BA.1 (5') and BA.2 (3'), breakpoint in nsp6 (ORF1a).
datasets.provenance: TODO: confirm a public GenBank XE genome and BA.1/BA.2 parent accessions before enabling (most XE genomes are GISAID-only). XE breakpoint ~nt 11556 (99% CI 9460-13866), in nsp6/ORF1a (Eurosurveillance; PMC9497488). Set enabled=true once accessions are confirmed on NCBI.

datasets.name: hcv_2k1b
datasets.description: HCV inter-genotype recombinant RF1_2k/1b (N687): genotype-2k 5' and genotype-1b 3', single breakpoint in NS2/NS3.
datasets.provenance: All accessions confirmed on NCBI nuccore. Query = RF1_2k/1b N687 AY587845 (9357 bp; the widely-transmitted St Petersburg inter-genotype recombinant; Virus Evolution 2019 vez041). 5' is genotype 2k, 3' genotype 1b, a single breakpoint in NS2/NS3 at ~nt 3175-3187 (H77 coords). References: 1b = Con1 AJ238799, 1a = H77 AF009606 (coordinate anchor). Pure genotype-2k full genomes are scarce, so genotype-2a JFH-1 AB047639 stands in for the 2k parent (the nearest available genotype 2), which the 5' should resolve to over genotype 1. The 3' 1b portion (~6.2 kb) exceeds the 5' portion (~3.2 kb), so 1b is the major parent and the genotype-2 5' is the donor region.

datasets.name: hcv_clonal_1b
datasets.description: HCV pure genotype-1b genome (non-recombinant clonal control): must resolve to 1b throughout with NO recombination called.
datasets.provenance: Real-data specificity (false-positive) control. Query = M58335, a pure HCV subtype-1b genome (9416 bp), against a 1b/2a/1a panel. A non-recombinant genome must be attributed to its own genotype (1b = Con1 AJ238799) across its full length with no recombination region called (max_regions 0). All accessions confirmed on NCBI nuccore.
